hero.title: Conversations that bring people closer.
hero.lead: Practical tools for everyday moments, get-to-know-you questions and party games. Works for parent–child, couples, friends and families.

what.title: What you’ll find
what.toolsDesc: Quick phrases and steps for tough moments (homework, emotions, limits, screen-time agreements…).
what.packsDesc: Openers, deeper conversations, memories and fun – always story-based.
what.gamesDesc: Icebreakers, “How well do you know me?” quizzes, team modes.
what.eduDesc: Blog, ebooks and videos (NVC, Gottman, CBT, ACT…). Practical and clear.
